summary_method: Arithmetic means of two per-run summaries with reversed/balanced execution order, not pooled percentiles or an overall desktop-speed score. Every comparison uses its own identical harness on both images.
limitations: Synthetic unpaced server planning/FIFO/codec/protocol output to a discard socket. No capture, RDP transport, browser paint, Wi-Fi or physical input. Fixed codec mode bypasses automatic classification. Hash-enabled integrity and diagnostic-on records are separate from default-off, hash-disabled performance summaries.
encoding_caveat: Production quality, method, lossless and codec policies remain unchanged. Only automatic workloads with equal realized codec/pixel/byte-count/quality work across both versions and orders support equal-work timing claims. Fixed comparisons enforce equal realized work; separate encoded-payload fingerprints add non-cryptographic content evidence.
memory_tradeoff: At most 2 MiB retained ARGB input per worker, allocated lazily: 44 MiB at 22 workers, 128 MiB at 64. Excludes other codec scratch, layers and transient oversized/nested encodes.

image_input_size_probe.policy_note: baseline never calls the setter and preserves its shipped policy (including private.6 default12); adaptive passes setter value1, enabling the candidate default12 rather than limiting it to one worker; only values greater than1 override the adaptive cap; fixed passes0 as a separate full-pool diagnostic; test_active_cap is the legacy setter-control value, not necessarily an observed worker count
image_input_size_probe.verification: separate untimed strict ASCII protocol replay with real PNG/lossless WebP decoding and exact RGB comparison of every fixture pixel after each checked frame; timing/RSS captured before verification; opaque fixed-size fixtures only, not a general browser or alpha/resize validator
image_input_size_probe.statistics_note: planner counter deltas cover measured frames only; scratch bytes are retained-capacity gauges; unavailable baseline counters are null, not zero
image_input_size_probe.planning_phase_timing_note: existing numeric TRACE phase durations captured without formatting; per-frame mean/p95 use integer-millisecond wall times; search includes both candidate indexing and copy search; zero phase durations are valid; phase quantiles cannot be subtracted from full-frame quantiles

encoder_control.method: benchmark-only ELF symbol interposition: auto forwards the original selector, fixed mode replaces only its decision, encoders always forward to the image's real implementations; hook coverage verified for every image; forced-lossless correctness replay disables overrides

encoded_fingerprints.method: per-image FNV-1a64 over concatenated encoded bytes before base64, aggregated as unsigned sum and XOR per codec independent of completion order; non-cryptographic integrity evidence alongside pixel replay, not a security proof
encoded_fingerprints.timing_note: enabled runs add per-byte hashing and must be excluded from headline performance comparisons; no encoded payloads retained or printed

image_input_size_probe.encoder_timing_note: summed per-image encoder wrapper wall times include codec work plus streaming/serialization/socket waits; concurrent sums are not frame latency or standalone codec CPU; instrumentation is identical on old/new libraries

render_diagnostics.note: optional numeric telemetry adds clocks only in supporting libraries; use separate diagnostic runs when an older baseline cannot collect it; microsecond cumulative measured-frame deltas, maxima include initialization/warmup; overlapping phase sums and quantiles are not additive; no network-delivery timing
